skill.name: d3-viz
skill.description: Create custom D3.js data visualizations, including charts, network diagrams, maps, hierarchies, interactions, transitions, scales, and reusable JavaScript patterns.
skill.summary: Create custom, interactive D3.js visualizations with reusable chart patterns and design guidance.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The static alerts are false positives caused by JavaScript template literals, Markdown code fences, SVG defs, style text, and object key names. No prompt injection, shell execution, filesystem access, secret access, or malicious network behavior was found. One semantic issue remains because tooltip examples render interpolated data through D3 .html(...), which can cause XSS if data is untrusted.

remediation.issue: Tooltip examples use interpolated data inside D3 HTML strings.
remediation.suggestion: Render untrusted values with text nodes or sanitize values before calling .html(...). Document this requirement near every tooltip example.

remediation.issue: The setup section suggests a CDN script as an option.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer package imports for build pipelines. If a CDN is required, document pinning and integrity controls.

static_findings.snippet: All modules (scales, axes, shapes, transitions, etc.) are accessible through the `d3` namespace.
- Use `.join()` instead of separate enter/update/exit selections
- `d3-patterns.md` - Comprehensive collection of visualisation patterns and code examples
- `scale-reference.md` - Complete guide to d3 scales with examples
- `colour-schemes.md` - D3 colour schemes and palette recommendations
- `interactive-template.js` - Template with tooltips, zoom, and interactions
- Ensure scales have valid domains (check for NaN values)
- Avoid unnecessary re-renders by checking dependencies

content.value_statement: Custom charts often need more control than standard chart libraries provide. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through D3 patterns for precise, interactive visualizations.
actual_capabilities: Guides D3 setup through npm imports or the official CDN.
Provides patterns for bar, line, scatter, pie, heatmap, map, network, and hierarchy charts.
Explains scales, axes, margins, responsive sizing, transitions, and D3 joins.
Includes React starter templates for basic and interactive charts.
Recommends color schemes, accessibility practices, and performance options for large datasets.
limitations: Does not include a runtime package or automatic chart renderer.
Examples require adaptation for each framework and dataset shape.
Generated tooltip HTML should be sanitized before use with untrusted data.
Large datasets may need canvas or aggregation beyond the SVG examples.

use_cases.title: Prototype a Product Dashboard
use_cases.description: Turn metric data into responsive charts with clear axes, labels, legends, and interaction states.

use_cases.title: Create Publication Visuals
use_cases.description: Design precise SVG charts, maps, and hierarchy diagrams for reports, articles, and research findings.

use_cases.title: Build Interactive Explorers
use_cases.description: Plan zooming, brushing, selection, and linked views for deeper analysis of complex datasets.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Bar Chart
prompt_templates.prompt: Use d3-viz to build a responsive bar chart from this dataset. Include scales, axes, labels, and accessible SVG text.

prompt_templates.title: Add Interactive Tooltips
prompt_templates.prompt: Use d3-viz to add safe hover tooltips, click selection, and keyboard focus states to an existing scatter plot.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Chart System
prompt_templates.prompt: Use d3-viz to define reusable D3 patterns for colors, scales, legends, and responsive chart containers in React.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Linked Map Explorer
prompt_templates.prompt: Use d3-viz to design linked brushing between a choropleth map and a detail chart. Include performance and accessibility constraints.

output_examples.input: Create a responsive sales bar chart for quarterly revenue.
output_examples.output: A chart plan with margins, band and linear scales, axes, labels, and React integration guidance.

output_examples.input: Add exploration tools to a scatter plot with thousands of points.
output_examples.output: Recommendations for zoom, brush selection, tooltip behavior, and when to switch from SVG to canvas.

output_examples.input: Choose a color palette for a risk heatmap.
output_examples.output: A sequential color recommendation with contrast guidance, legend design, and color blindness checks.

best_practices: Validate and normalize data before binding it to visual elements.
Use D3 for scales, layouts, and transitions while respecting the host framework lifecycle.
Prefer accessible SVG structure, clear labels, and safe text rendering for user-provided data.
anti_patterns: Do not use D3 for simple charts when a standard chart library already fits.
Do not recreate the whole SVG on every small interaction without a performance reason.
Do not inject untrusted data into tooltip HTML without escaping or sanitization.

faq.question: When should I use this skill instead of a chart library?
faq.answer: Use it when you need custom layouts, detailed SVG control, or advanced interactions beyond standard components.

faq.question: Does this skill work with React?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes React templates and explains how to use D3 inside component lifecycle hooks.

faq.question: Can it help with maps and networks?
faq.answer: Yes. The references include geographic, force-directed, hierarchy, chord, heatmap, and linked interaction patterns.

faq.question: Does it generate finished production code automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides patterns and templates that still need testing, styling, and data-specific adaptation.

faq.question: How should I handle large datasets?
faq.answer: Use aggregation, canvas rendering, or virtualization when SVG creates too many DOM elements.

faq.question: What security step matters most for generated charts?
faq.answer: Treat chart data as untrusted and avoid inserting raw values into HTML tooltips.
